mentions.name: Patient Management SaaS for Doctors
mentions.description: A SaaS patient management system for doctors that gives a complete picture of each patient, including visit history, diagnoses, suggested medications, and billing. It is being built with a Nest.js backend and a Next.js frontend using the Shadcn UI library.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have started working on a SaaS for Doctors. It is basically a patient management system where Doctor's can get complete picture of their patients like visit history, diagnosis, medications suggested, billing etc. I am using Nest.js for backend and Next.js for frontend (Shadcn UI Library)
